```{r}
#Data overview and conversion
HF_DS <- read.csv('heart_failure.csv')

summary(HF_DS) #Summary stats

# Convert outcome to factor 
HF_DS$heart_failure <- factor(HF_DS$heart_failure, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('Absent', 'Present')) #Convert 0/1 to Absent/Present

HF_DS$sex_male <- factor(HF_DS$sex_male, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('Female', 'Male')) #Convert 0/1 to Female/Male

HF_DS$smoking <- factor(HF_DS$smoking, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$diabetes <- factor(HF_DS$diabetes, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$hypertension <- factor(HF_DS$hypertension, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$anaemia <- factor(HF_DS$anaemia, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$prior_mi <- factor(HF_DS$prior_mi, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$atrial_fibrillation <- factor(HF_DS$atrial_fibrillation, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$med_acei <- factor(HF_DS$med_acei, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$med_beta_blocker <- factor(HF_DS$med_beta_blocker, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c('No', 'yes')) #Convert 0/1 to No/Yes

HF_DS$med_diuretic <- factor(HF_DS$med_diuretic,

head(HF_DS)

#Get gender count:
Gender <- HF_DS %>%

Gender
```

```{r}
#Check outliers through interquartile range (IQR) 
identify_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
  upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  sum(x < lower_bound | x > upper_bound, na.rm = TRUE)
}

#Get otlier counts
outlier_counts <- sapply(HF_DS[continuous_vars], identify_outliers)
print('Number of outliers per variable:')
print(outlier_counts)
```

```{r}
#Categorising variables
#Continous variables into categorical variables
HF_DS <- HF_DS %>%
  mutate(
    # Age categories
    age_cat = case_when(
      age < 50 ~ 'Under 50',
      age >= 50 & age < 65 ~ '50-64',
      age >= 65 & age < 75 ~ '65-74',
      age >= 75 ~ '75+'
    ),
    #BMI categories
    bmi_cat = case_when(
      bmi < 18.5 ~ 'Underweight',
      bmi >= 18.5 & bmi < 25 ~ 'Normal',
      bmi >= 25 & bmi < 30 ~ 'Overweight',
      bmi >= 30 ~ 'Obese'
    ),
    #EF categories
    ef_cat = case_when(
      ejection_fraction < 40 ~ 'HFrEF (Reduced)',
      ejection_fraction >= 40 & ejection_fraction < 50 ~ 'HFmrEF (Mid-range)',
      ejection_fraction >= 50 ~ 'HFpEF (Preserved)'
    ),
    #NT-proBNP categoires
    ntprobnp_cat = case_when(
      ntprobnp_pg_ml < 125 ~ 'Normal',
      ntprobnp_pg_ml >= 125 & ntprobnp_pg_ml < 450 ~ 'Elevated (age < 75)',
      ntprobnp_pg_ml >= 450 ~ 'Elevated'
    ),
    #eGFR categories
    eGFR_cat = case_when(
      eGFR_ckdepi >= 90 ~ 'Stage 1 - Normal',
      eGFR_ckdepi >= 60 & eGFR_ckdepi < 90 ~ 'Stage 2 - Mild loss',
      eGFR_ckdepi >= 45 & eGFR_ckdepi < 60 ~ 'Stage 3 - Mild to moderate loss',
      eGFR_ckdepi >= 30 & eGFR_ckdepi < 45 ~ 'Stage 4 - Moderate to severe loss',
      eGFR_ckdepi < 30 ~ 'Stage 5 - Severe loss'
    )
  )

#Check  distributions
table(HF_DS$age_cat, HF_DS$heart_failure)
table(HF_DS$bmi_cat, HF_DS$heart_failure)
table(HF_DS$ef_cat, HF_DS$heart_failure)
table(HF_DS$ntprobnp_cat, HF_DS$heart_failure)
table(HF_DS$eGFR_cat, HF_DS$heart_failure)

```

```{r}

# Split data into training set and test set (80/20)
set.seed(327489)
HF_DS <- HF_DS %>%
  mutate(rvar = runif(n())) %>%
  arrange(rvar) %>%
  mutate(S = if_else(row_number() > n() * 0.8, 1, 0))

train_data <- HF_DS %>% filter(S == 0)
test_data <- HF_DS %>% filter(S == 1)
```


```{r}
#Compare categorical vs. continous variables

#Age

chisq.test(table(train_data$age_cat, train_data$heart_failure))

model_age_con <- glm(heart_failure ~ age, 
                          data = train_data, 
                          family = binomial())
  
model_age_cat <- glm(heart_failure ~ age_cat, 
                           data = train_data, 
                           family = binomial())
  
lrtest(model_age_con, model_age_cat)

#BMI

chisq.test(table(train_data$bmi_cat, train_data$heart_failure))

model_bmi_con <- glm(heart_failure ~ bmi, 
                        data = train_data, 
                        family = binomial())

model_bmi_cat <- glm(heart_failure ~ bmi_cat, 
                         data = train_data, 
                         family = binomial())

lrtest(model_bmi_con, model_bmi_cat)

#EF

chisq.test(table(train_data$ef_cat, train_data$heart_failure))

model_ef_con <- glm(heart_failure ~ ejection_fraction, 
                        data = train_data,

model_ef_cat <- glm(heart_failure ~ ef_cat, 
                         data = train_data,

lrtest(model_ef_con, model_ef_cat)

#ntprobnp_pg_ml
```

```{r}
train_data_scaled <- train_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), scale))

#Refit model with scaled
model_scaled <- glm(heart_failure ~ age + sex_male + bmi + heart_rate + 
                    systolic_bp + ejection_fraction + ntprobnp_pg_ml +
                    serum_creatinine_mg_dl,
                    data = train_data_scaled,
                    family = binomial())

#Confidence intervals
importance_scaled <- tidy(model_scaled) %>%
  filter(term != '(Intercept)') %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))
print(importance_scaled)
```

```{r}
#Create logistic regression full model
full_model <- glm(heart_failure ~ age + sex_male + bmi + heart_rate + 
                  systolic_bp + diastolic_bp + ejection_fraction + 
                  ntprobnp_pg_ml + serum_creatinine_mg_dl + eGFR_ckdepi +
                  smoking + diabetes + hypertension + anaemia + prior_mi + 
                  atrial_fibrillation + med_acei + med_beta_blocker + med_diuretic,
                  data = train_data,
                  family = binomial())

#Summary stats for full model
summary(full_model)
```

```{r}
#Stepwise selection AIC
step_model <- stepAIC(full_model, direction = 'both', trace = FALSE)
summary(step_model)

#Odds ratios
tidy(step_model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
```


```{r}
#5-fold cross validation 
ctrl <- trainControl(method = 'cv', number = 5, classProbs = TRUE, 
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary) #Get sensitivity, specificity, and ROC

#Train model
cv_model <- train(heart_failure ~ ejection_fraction + ntprobnp_pg_ml + age + eGFR_ckdepi + sex_male,
                  data = train_data,
                  method = 'glm',
                  family = 'binomial',
                  trControl = ctrl,
                  metric = 'ROC')
print(cv_model$results)
```


```{r}
#Sensitivity analysis
#Bootstrap AUC - Refit model on 100 bootstrap and calculate AUC 
set.seed(123)
boot_auc <- replicate(100, {
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(train_data), replace = TRUE)
  boot_fit <- glm(heart_failure ~ ejection_fraction + ntprobnp_pg_ml + age,
                  data = train_data[idx, ], family = binomial())
  pred <- predict(boot_fit, newdata = train_data[-idx, ], type = 'response')
  auc(roc(train_data$heart_failure[-idx], pred))
})
cat('Bootstrap 95% CI for AUC:', quantile(boot_auc, c(0.025, 0.975)), '\n')

#Subgroup analysis stratified by age
train_data$age_65 <- ifelse(train_data$age >= 65, '65+', '<65') #Create categories
model_young <- glm(heart_failure ~ ejection_fraction + ntprobnp_pg_ml,
                   data = train_data[train_data$age_65 == '<65', ], family = binomial())
model_old   <- glm(heart_failure ~ ejection_fraction + ntprobnp_pg_ml,
                   data = train_data[train_data$age_65 == '65+', ], family = binomial())

train_data %>%
  count(age_65) #Count subgroup sizes
```


```{r}
# Compare odds ratios for subgroup analysis through odds ratios
tidy(model_young, exponentiate = TRUE)
tidy(model_old, exponentiate = TRUE)
```



```{r}
#Create final model on training data
final_model <- glm(heart_failure ~ age + ejection_fraction + ntprobnp_pg_ml + 
                   eGFR_ckdepi + atrial_fibrillation + sex_male,
                   data = train_data,
                   family = binomial())
test_data$pred <- predict(final_model, newdata = test_data, type = 'response') #Predicted probabilities on test test

#ROC and AUC curve
library(pROC)
test_roc <- roc(test_data$heart_failure, test_data$pred)
auc_val <- auc(test_roc)
cat('Test set AUC:', round(auc_val, 3), '\n')

#Youden's index to get optimal thresholds
opt_thresh <- coords(test_roc, 'best', ret = 'threshold')$threshold
pred_class <- factor(ifelse(test_data$pred > opt_thresh, 'Yes', 'No'), 
                     levels = c('No', 'Yes'))



#Convert heart failure labels to yes / no for confusion matrix
actual <- ifelse(test_data$heart_failure %in% c('Yes', 'Present'), 'Yes', 'No')

# Create predicted class
pred_class <- ifelse(test_data$pred > opt_thresh, 'Yes', 'No')


# Confusion matrix
cm <- confusionMatrix(data = factor(pred_class), 
                      reference = factor(actual), 
                      positive = 'Yes')
print(cm)

#Calibration plot (obsereved v predicted)
cal_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(pred_decile = ntile(pred, 10)) %>%
  group_by(pred_decile) %>%
  summarise(observed = mean(heart_failure == 'Present'),
            predicted = mean(pred), .groups = 'drop')
ggplot(cal_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = 'Calibration Plot (Test Set)', x = 'Predicted Probability', y = 'Observed Proportion') +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Hosmer Lemeshow goodness of fit test
#Test if predicted probabilities match observed event rates
hl_test <- hoslem.test(as.numeric(test_data$heart_failure) - 1, test_data$pred, g = 10)
print(hl_test)
```
